## Project Overview

### Product
A Laravel-based Admission Management and Student Management Information System (MIS) for Nigerian academic institutions. Manages complete student lifecycle from admission to graduation with NUC-compliant result processing.

### Main Users
- Applicants (prospective students)
- Students (enrolled students)
- Admin (system administrators)
- HOD (Heads of Department)
- Lecturers (faculty members)
- Exam Officers (result approvers)
- CIT (technical support)
- Coordinators (programme coordinators)
- IdCard Officers (ID card management)

### Main Workflow
1. User registration (applicant/student/admin)
2. Application submission with document uploads
3. Application review and approval
4. Fee payment processing
5. Course registration
6. Result processing (Phases 1-4 COMPLETED; Phase 5 UP NEXT — see [`result_processing_agent_phases.md`](file:///c:/laragon/www/admission/result_processing_agent_phases.md) as single source of truth)
7. Graduation processing (Phase 6 pending — see [`result_processing_agent_phases.md`](file:///c:/laragon/www/admission/result_processing_agent_phases.md))

### What Makes This Different
- NUC-compliant grading system for Nigerian universities
- Course versioning for historical data integrity
- Automatic carry-over course registration
- Department-level unit validation
- Comprehensive role-based access control
- Production-safe deployment strategies (no Git/staging)

## User Roles & Privileges

### Role: Admin
**Can:**
- Full system access
- User management (create, edit, delete)
- Role management
- Department and programme management
- Course management
- Fee structure configuration
- System configuration

**Cannot:**
- None (full access)

**Accessible Modules:**
- All modules

### Role: Applicant
**Can:**
- Register account
- Submit application
- Upload documents (O-level results, certificates)
- Make payments
- View application status
- Update profile

**Cannot:**
- Access other users' data
- Modify system configuration
- Approve applications

**Accessible Modules:**
- Application portal
- Payment portal
- Profile management

### Role: Student
**Can:**
- Register for courses
- View results (when implemented)
- Make fee payments
- View academic details
- Request transcripts (when implemented)
- Update profile

**Cannot:**
- Modify course data
- Approve results
- Access other students' data

**Accessible Modules:**
- Student portal
- Course registration
- Fee payment
- Result viewing

### Role: HOD (Head of Department)
**Can:**
- Manage department courses
- Approve department applications
- View department student data
- Approve results (when implemented)
- Allocate courses to lecturers

**Cannot:**
- Access other departments' data
- Modify system-wide configuration

**Accessible Modules:**
- HOD portal
- Department management
- Result review and approval (`/hod/results-review`)

### Role: Lecturer
**Can:**
- Enter results for assigned courses (CA 0–40, Exam 0–60)
- View allocated courses
- Download CSV template and upload bulk results
- Submit results for HOD approval

**Cannot:**
- Approve results
- Access other lecturers' data
- Modify course structure

**Accessible Modules:**
- Lecturer portal (`/lecturer/dashboard`)
- Result entry (`/lecturer/result-entry/{courseAllocation}`)

### Role: Exam Officer
**Can:**
- Audit and review coordinator-approved results across departments
- Generate and export **Departmental Broadsheets**, **Course Score Sheets**, and **Senate Summary Reports** for Academic Board / Senate approval
- Release official semester results to students (auto-triggering GPA and carry-over updates)
- Return results to Coordinator with feedback remarks
- Generate result and performance statistics

**Cannot:**
- Enter initial scores directly (handled by allocated lecturer)

**Accessible Modules:**
- Exam officer portal (`/exam-officer/dashboard`)
- Result auditing, Senate broadsheets, and release (`/exam-officer/results-review`)

### Role: CIT
**Can:**
- System administration
- Technical support
- User account management

**Cannot:**
- Modify academic data
- Access financial data

**Accessible Modules:**
- Admin portal (technical)

### Role: Coordinator
**Can:**
- Review and approve submitted course cohort results
- Export Departmental Score Sheets and cohort result summaries for Departmental Board of Examiners
- Return results to Lecturer with required correction remarks
- Oversee student cohort progress and academic standing
- Generate Student PINs for course registration

**Cannot:**
- Enter initial scores directly (handled by allocated lecturer)
- Release results directly to students without Exam Officer / Senate release

**Accessible Modules:**
- Coordinator portal (`/coordinator/dashboard`)
- Course cohort result review (`/coordinator/result-review`)
- Student PIN generation (`/coordinator/generate-student-pin`)

### Role: IdCard Officer
**Can:**
- Generate ID cards
- Manage ID card requests
- Print ID cards

**Cannot:**
- Access other modules
- Modify student data

**Accessible Modules:**
- ID card management

## Authentication & Authorization

### Authentication Flow
```
Login
  ↓
Credentials validated (email/password)
  ↓
User authenticated via Laravel Sanctum
  ↓
Session/token created
  ↓
Frontend stores authentication state
  ↓
Requests include authentication header
  ↓
Middleware verifies user
  ↓
Authorization checks permission via Policies
```

### Authentication Mechanism
- **Method:** Laravel Sanctum (token-based)
- **Session:** Session-based for web
- **Password:** Hashed using Laravel's Hash facade
- **Reset:** Email-based password reset

### Authorization
- **Policies:** UserPolicy, RolePolicy, CategoryPolicy, ItemPolicy
- **Middleware:** Role-based middleware on routes
- **Gates:** Custom gates for specific permissions

## Database Architecture

### Important Tables

#### `users`
**Purpose:** User accounts with UUID primary keys

**Important Columns:**
- `id` (UUID, primary key)
- `email` (unique)
- `phone` (unique, nullable)
- `jamb_no` (unique, nullable)
- `role` (enum: applicant, student, graduate, hod, admin)
- `surname`, `firstname`, `m_name`
- `programme_id` (foreign key)
- `password`, `vpassword`
- `picture` (profile image)

**Relationships:**
- hasOne AcademicDetail
- hasMany Transactions
- belongsTo Programme

**Used By:** Authentication, user management

#### `programmes`
**Purpose:** Academic programmes (Undergraduate, Postgraduate, HND, ND, NCE, PD)

**Important Columns:**
- `id`
- `name`
- `code`
- `duration`

**Relationships:**
- hasMany Users
- belongsToMany Departments (via department_programmes)

#### `departments`
**Purpose:** Department management

**Important Columns:**
- `id`
- `name`
- `code`
- `school_id`

**Relationships:**
- belongsTo School
- hasMany Users
- hasMany DepartmentCourses

#### `courses`
**Purpose:** Course catalog

**Important Columns:**
- `id`
- `code`
- `name`
- `units`

**Relationships:**
- hasMany DepartmentCourses

#### `department_courses`
**Purpose:** Course allocation to departments

**Important Columns:**
- `id`
- `department_id`
- `student_course_id`
- `units`

**Relationships:**
- belongsTo Department
- belongsTo Course (via student_course_id)
- hasMany RegisteredCourses

**Important Constraints:**
- Foreign key to departments
- Foreign key to courses

#### `registered_courses`
**Purpose:** Student course registrations

**Important Columns:**
- `id`
- `academic_detail_id`
- `department_course_id` (unique constraint - ISSUE: prevents carry-overs)
- `student_level_id`
- `units` (string - should be integer)
- `academic_session`

**Relationships:**
- belongsTo AcademicDetail
- belongsTo DepartmentCourse
- belongsTo StudentLevel

**Important Constraints:**
- Unique on department_course_id (prevents retakes - needs fixing)

#### `academic_details`
**Purpose:** Student academic information & cohort tracking

**Important Columns:**
- `id`
- `user_id`
- `matric_no` (unique)
- `course_id` (foreign key to courses)
- `programme_id`
- `department_id`
- `student_level_id`
- `acad_session` (e.g. '2024/2025')
- `admission_session` (e.g. '2024/2025' - essential for cohort-specific coordinator mapping)
- `coordinator_id` (nullable legacy coordinator reference)

**Relationships:**
- belongsTo User
- belongsTo Programme
- belongsTo Department
- belongsTo StudentLevel
- belongsTo Course
- belongsTo Coordinator
- hasMany RegisteredCourses

#### `transactions`
**Purpose:** Fee payment transactions

**Important Columns:**
- `id`
- `transaction_id`
- `user_id` (UUID)
- `amount` (string - should be decimal)
- `date` (string - should be date)
- `status`
- `RRR` (unique, nullable)
- `acad_session`

**Relationships:**
- belongsTo User

**Important Constraints:**
- Unique RRR for payment reference

#### `olevels`, `olevel_exams`, `olevel_subject_grades`
**Purpose:** O-level result management

**Important Columns:**
- `user_id` (UUID, no index - needs index)
- Subject grades, exam types

**Relationships:**
- belongsTo User

#### `department_max_units`
**Purpose:** Department-level unit constraints

**Important Columns:**
- `department_id`
- `student_level_id`
- `max_units`

**Needs Extension:**
- Add `min_units` field
- Rename to `department_level_units`

## Important Business Rules

### Application Submission Rule
An application cannot be submitted until:
1. Required personal information is completed
2. Required documents are uploaded (O-level results, certificates)
3. Payment has been confirmed
4. Programme and department are selected

### Course Registration Rule
A student cannot register for courses unless:
1. Fee payment is confirmed for the session
2. Total units are within department min/max limits (when implemented)
3. Prerequisite courses are completed (when implemented)
4. Course is offered in the current session

### Fee Payment Rule
Payment is required before:
1. Application submission
2. Course registration
3. Transcript request (when implemented)

### Result Approval Rule
Results follow a strict multi-level approval state machine:

| Status | Set By | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `pending` | System / Coordinator Return | Lecturer draft — editable |
| `submitted` | Lecturer | Locked, awaiting Course Cohort Coordinator review |
| `exam_officer_approved` | Coordinator | Approved by Coordinator, awaiting Exam Officer release |
| `released` | Exam Officer | Official; visible to students; GPA & carry-overs computed |

1. Lecturer enters CA + Exam scores and clicks **Submit to Coordinator** → `pending` → `submitted` (automatically directed to each student's course cohort coordinator via `courseCohortCoordinator`)
2. Coordinator reviews the score sheet:
   - If correct → clicks **Approve & Forward** → `submitted` → `exam_officer_approved` (records `coordinator_approved_by` and `coordinator_approved_at`)
   - If issues found → clicks **Return to Lecturer**, types detailed reason → `submitted` → `pending` (remarks saved; scores unlocked again so lecturer can correct and resubmit)
3. Exam Officer audits coordinator-approved score sheets:
   - If correct → clicks **Release to Students** → `exam_officer_approved` → `released` (auto-triggers GPA & carry-over computation)
   - If issues found → clicks **Return to Coordinator**, types reason → `exam_officer_approved` → `submitted` (returned to coordinator queue)

## Main Workflows

### User Registration Workflow
```
User Registration
  ↓
Profile Completion (personal details)
  ↓
Role Selection (applicant/student/admin)
  ↓
Account Created
  ↓
Email Verification (if enabled)
```

### Application Workflow
```
Login as Applicant
  ↓
Select Programme and Department
  ↓
Upload O-level Results
  ↓
Upload Certificates
  ↓
Make Payment
  ↓
Submit Application
  ↓
Application Review (Admin/HOD)
  ↓
Status Update (Shortlisted/Recommended/Pending)
  ↓
Admission Offer (if approved)
```

### Course Registration Workflow
```
Login as Student
  ↓
View Available Courses
  ↓
Select Courses (within unit limits)
  ↓
Register Courses
  ↓
Fee Payment Confirmation
  ↓
Registration Confirmed
```

### Result Processing Workflow (IMPLEMENTED)
```
Admin/CIT Allocates Course to Lecturer (CourseAllocationManager)
  ↓
Lecturer Enters Scores — CA (0–40) + Exam (0–60) (ResultEntry)
  ↓
  [Optional: CSV Template Download → Bulk Fill → CSV Import]
  ↓
Lecturer Submits → status = 'submitted' (routed to student's Course Cohort Coordinator)
  ↓
Coordinator Reviews Course Cohort Score Sheet (CoordinatorResultReview)
  ├── Issues Found → Return to Lecturer + Reason → status = 'pending'
  │     ↓ (Lecturer corrects and resubmits)
  └── Approved → status = 'exam_officer_approved'
        ↓
Exam Officer Audits (ExamOfficerResultReview)
  ├── Issues Found → Return to Coordinator + Audit Comment → status = 'submitted'
  └── Release to Students → status = 'released'
        ↓
GPA / CGPA Calculated (GradeCalculationService → result_gpa_records)
        ↓
Carry-Over Courses Processed (CarryOverRegistrationService → carry_over_courses)
        ↓
[Future: Transcript Generation]
```

## API / Routes

### Public Routes (web.php)
- `/` - Landing page
- `/login` - Login page
- `/register` - Registration page
- `/password/reset` - Password reset

### Admin Routes (admin.php) — middleware: auth, role:admin
- `/admin/dashboard` - Admin dashboard
- `/admin/manage-capabilities` - Assign/revoke multi-role staff capabilities
- `/admin/course-allocations` - Allocate department courses to lecturers

### HOD Routes (hod.php) — middleware: auth, role:hod
- `/hod/dashboard` - HOD dashboard
- `/hod/results-review` - Score sheet review and batch approval or return to lecturer

### Lecturer Routes (lecturer.php) — middleware: auth, capability:lecturer
- `/lecturer/dashboard` - Allocated courses overview
- `/lecturer/result-entry/{courseAllocation}` - Inline score entry, CSV export/import, submit to HOD

### Exam Officer Routes (exam_officer.php) — middleware: auth, capability:exam_officer
- `/exam-officer/dashboard` - Exam officer dashboard
- `/exam-officer/results-review` - Faculty-wide grade auditing and official result release

### Student Routes (student.php) — middleware: auth, role:student
- `/student/dashboard` - Student portal
- `/student/course-registration` - Course registration
- `/student/course-history` - Academic history

### Authentication Middleware
- `auth` - Require authentication
- `role:admin` - Require admin role
- `role:student` - Require student role
- `role:hod` - Require HOD role
- `capability:lecturer` - Require lecturer capability (via `user_capabilities` table)
- `capability:exam_officer` - Require exam officer capability

## Backend Architecture

### Business Logic Location
```
Controller
  ↓
Form Request (validation)
  ↓
Service (business logic)
  ↓
Model (data access)
  ↓
Database
```

### Important Architectural Conventions

## Payments

### Payment Provider
- Remita (via RRR)
- Integration through transaction system

### Payment Flow
```
Create Payment Transaction
  ↓
Generate RRR
  ↓
User Pays via Remita
  ↓
Callback/Webhook
  ↓
Verify Transaction
  ↓
Update Transaction Status
  ↓
Update Business Record (application/course registration)
  ↓
Generate Receipt
```

### Database Records
- `transactions` table stores payment data
- `RRR` field for Remita reference
- Status tracking (pending, approved, activated)

## File Uploads and Storage

### Upload Locations
- `storage/app/public/profile` - Profile pictures
- `storage/app/public/certificates` - Certificate uploads
- `storage/app/public/olevel` - O-level documents
- `storage/app/public/post-utme` - Post-UTME documents

### Storage Disks
- `local` - Local storage
- `public` - Publicly accessible files (via storage link)

### File Naming
- Stored with unique names
- Original filename preserved in database

### Validation
- Image files: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, tiff (max 4MB)
- Documents: pdf, doc, docx (varies by upload type)

### Database Reference vs Physical File
- Database stores file path
- Physical file in storage directory
- Both must be deleted together

## Known Problems

### Issue: registered_courses Unique Constraint
**Symptoms:** Students cannot retake courses (carry-overs)
**Cause:** Unique constraint on `department_course_id` prevents duplicate registrations
**Current Workaround:** Manual database intervention
**Relevant Files:** `database/migrations/2025_02_12_181130_create_registered_courses_table.php`
**Status:** Open - needs fix in production-safe manner

### Issue: Missing Database Indexes
**Symptoms:** Slow queries on user-related data
**Cause:** No indexes on foreign keys in several tables
**Current Workaround:** None
**Relevant Files:** Multiple migration files
**Status:** Open - documented in DATABASE_OPTIMIZATION_PRODUCTION_SAFE.md

### Issue: Incorrect Data Types
**Symptoms:** Cannot perform arithmetic on amount/date fields
**Cause:** `transactions.amount` is string instead of decimal, `date` is string instead of date
**Current Workaround:** Type casting in application code
**Relevant Files:** `database/migrations/2024_05_23_212041_create_transactions_table.php`
**Status:** Open - needs production-safe migration

## Technical Decisions

### Decision: UUID for User Primary Keys
User model uses UUID for primary keys instead of auto-increment integers.
**Reason:** Better security, prevents enumeration attacks
**Impact:** All foreign keys to users are UUIDs

### Decision: Role-based Access Control
Authorization handled through Policies and middleware.
**Reason:** Flexible, maintainable, Laravel standard
**Impact:** All role checks use Policies

### Decision: Livewire for Frontend
Interactive UI components built with Livewire.
**Reason:** No need for separate API, Laravel-native, reactive
**Impact:** All interactive forms use Livewire components

### Decision: No Git/Staging for Production
Direct deployment to production without version control.
**Reason:** User's current setup
**Impact:** Requires careful backup procedures before changes

- Do not change the database schema without checking dependent code
- Do not remove existing fields simply because they appear unused
- Do not change authentication middleware without checking all portals
- Do not expose private uploaded files
- Do not commit environment secrets
- Do not replace existing Livewire patterns unnecessarily
- Do not modify unique constraints without checking for carry-over functionality
- Do not deploy to production without backup (CRITICAL - no Git/staging)
- Do not run migrations without --force flag in production
- Do not install packages without testing locally first
- Do not change data types without production-safe migration plan

## Instructions for AI Coding Agents

Before modifying code:

1. Read this file completely
2. Identify the relevant module
3. Check the referenced files
4. Understand the existing workflow
5. Check database relationships and permissions
6. Check whether the change affects API/mobile/frontend consumers
7. Make the smallest safe change
8. Preserve existing architecture and conventions
9. Run relevant tests
10. Report files changed and why

### Important for This Project

**CRITICAL:** This system is in production with NO Git/staging environment.

**Before ANY production change:**
1. Create full database backup
2. Test changes locally
3. Review production deployment guide: `PRODUCTION_PACKAGE_DEDUCTION.md`
4. Use maintenance mode during critical changes
5. Have rollback plan ready

**Do not:**
- Invent architecture
- Duplicate existing services
- Bypass authorization
- Expose secrets
- Modify unrelated features
- Perform destructive database operations without explicit instruction
- Silently change business rules
- Deploy without backup
- Run migrations without --force flag in production

**Production-Specific Rules:**
- Always backup before any change
- Use direct deployment method (no Git)
- Test locally first
- Follow production-safe guides
- Monitor for 24 hours after deployment
